items.title: How Meta's Muse is driving a magic moment for the stock market
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi shares his thoughts on the impact of Meta's (META) Muse AI agent on the broader stock market.

items.title: Meta’s Muse is a game changer—but can it win consumers' trust?
items.summary: The 8:30 Hosts Julie Hyman, Jake Conley, and Pras Subramanian discuss how Meta's (META) new AI agent, Muse, could pose challenges to user trust and why being first may not be enough, as rivals like Apple (AAPL) and Google (GOOG) could prepare their own responses.

items.title: Meta’s new AI agent just got me $250 in flight credits
items.summary: In the Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen recounts how Muse, Meta's (META) new AI agent, helped get him $250 in flight credits and rebooked a new flight after his original flight was delayed, demonstrating how users can now interact with an agent that handles web-based tasks on their behalf and shifts the role of the operational driver from human to AI.

items.title: Should investors play AI bottlenecks over social media stocks?
items.summary: Should investors bet more on the AI infrastructure bottlenecks than on other tech trends, such as social media? Today's Market Hang panel consists of Host Turney Duff, Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi, Defiance ETFs CIO Sylvia Jablonski, Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick, and Gerber Kawasaki Wealth & Investment Management CEO Ross Gerber.

items.title: Meta has 'enormous advantage' in rally sparked by new Muse AI
items.summary: Meta Platforms (META) stock is trying to hold onto gains from its latest rally fueled by the release of its new Muse AI chatbot. Is this another big moment for the Big Tech company or are investors still wary of trust concerns? Today's Market Hang panel consists of Host Turney Duff, Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi, Defiance ETFs CIO Sylvia Jablonski, Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick, and Gerber Kawasaki Wealth & Investment Management CEO Ross Gerber.

items.summary: Innodata Inc (INOD) witnessed a jump in share price last session on above-average trading volume. The latest trend in earnings estimate revisions for the stock doesn't suggest further strength down the road.

items.summary: The AI assistant is starting to reshape Wall Street forecasts.
